record.body:
## Evidence

Frames (time: non-goal sections):
16:33:51 Ready [add-greet-module], Waiting [add-greet-cli]
16:34:03 Running [add-greet-module sub-greet-module], Waiting [add-greet-cli]
16:35:03 Running [add-greet-cli sub-greet-cli], Done Recent [add-greet-module]
16:36:45 Running [add-greet-cli sub-greet-cli-2], Done Recent [add-greet-module]
16:38:20 Done Recent [add-greet-cli, add-greet-module]

The first executor for add-greet-cli worked in /tmp instead of ~/tmp; the parent re-check failed it, recorded a fail check-run and an amendment, and a second executor passed. The dashboard shows the reassignment.

## Consequence

The criterion's literal wording (task two shows Ready) is not met. watch cannot show a state shorter than its interval; this is by design.

## Follow-up

User decides: accept the log and sign the manual check-run, or ask for a rerun with a pause after each close.

payload.basis: ~/tmp/dash-e2e-frames.final.log: 6 frames; add-greet-cli goes Waiting -> Running [sub-greet-cli] -> Running [sub-greet-cli-2] -> Done Recent; the parent list call at the time returned it as ready
payload.claim: The real run frame log shows every transition except add-greet-cli in Ready; that state lasted under one 2 s watch interval
payload.invalidated_when: A rerun with a pause between close and dispatch shows the Ready frame, or the user accepts the log as is
